scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game (original with hook off vs candidate with hook on, hooked in CGame::Process), 6336 isolated CPU pairs for the 15 functions, zero differences, natural completion event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same fixture from the same seed in both legs and compares the result, the fixture state (hash or bytes), the x87 control word (24-bit precision) and the ordered trace of every outgoing call with raw arguments; the hook jump state is checked. CRoadBlocks: the global block 0xA43438..0xA43C78 is saved/restored; ThePaths areas 61 (unloaded), 62 and 63 are replaced by fake nodes (0x1C), navigation links and CCarPathLink (0xE) with pointers and m_anNumAddresses restored; fake 0xA40-byte entities with a fake vtable (slot 0 = traced deleting destructor). CPools: the object pool pointer (0xB7449C) is swapped for a fake 4-slot pool of 0x19C bytes and restored. CIdleCam: fake 0x9C-byte object with guards and a fake 0x300-byte camera; CPad 0, CTimer, the gIdleCam ticker, the InterestingEvents byte, the active camera of TheCamera and CWorld::pIgnoreEntity are saved/restored. Traced stubs, which get NO credit: FindObjectsIntersectingCube, CWorld::Remove/Add, CanBeDeleted of vehicle/ped/object, rand (0x821B1E) and CGeneral::GetRandomNumber (same sequence), FindPlayerWanted/Vehicle/Coors/Ped, CreateRoadBlockBetween2Points (trace only), CWorld::ProcessLineOfSight, CProjectileInfo::RemoveIfThisIsAProjectile, CObject::operator new and constructor, the EXE printf (0x821982; the DLL does not call it, so CheckPoolsEmpty is compared by state only: nothing must change), RegisterReference, CleanUpOldReference and GetIsLineOfSightClear. Only the own part of each function is validated. Bench noise declared: CIdleCam::SetTarget with denormal floats (SSE DAZ/FTZ in the DLL vs x87 in the EXE) fails only when m_Target is null and a component is a small integer (denormal) added to 0.0; the camera vectors are normalised in the fixture (FillIdle) so no denormals reach the function. Excluded from the bench and NOT credited: CRoadBlocks::Init, CRoadBlocks::GenerateRoadBlockPedsForCar, CPools::Initialise, ShutDown, Save, Load, LoadPedPool, LoadObjectPool and LoadVehiclePool, CIdleCam::FinaliseIdleCamera, ProcessSlerp, ProcessTargetSelection, Run and Process, and the whole of CCam. Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.
